Answer: C
Reason: Comparing Figure 1 and Figure 2 reveals that the extensive consolidation previously seen in the left lung has significantly cleared, while new patchy consolidations have appeared in the right lung. This pattern of resolving infiltrates in one area accompanied by new infiltrates in another is characteristic of migratory pulmonary infiltrates, a hallmark finding of Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP).
